remarks: Spacious apartment in downtown Greenwich at a boutique luxury rental building. Prime location; Next to Equinox, an elite health and wellness experience. Minutes from coveted Greenwich Avenue. And a short ride to New York City at the Greenwich Train Station. Unit 6 features an expansive open floor plan with a chef's kitchen, gas fireplace, and private balcony. 2 large sunny bedrooms both with ensuite baths. (One bath is ADA accessible as is the building). Rental includes access to two covered/heated garage spaces (possible to add EV charging capability), rooftop deck with gas grill, and downtown views.
